# Apexfission Permissions

> Android runtime permission explanations, Compose gates, callback helpers and staged platform recipes. Minimum Android API 24. This documentation follows main. Read IMPORT.md for published versions and installation; never infer a version from source.

## Consumer documentation

- [Authoritative installation and released version (IMPORT.md)](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/IMPORT.md)

- [Agent entry point](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/index.md)
- [Complete quickstart](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/quickstart.md)
- [Public API and contracts](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/api.md)
- [Concepts and ownership](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/concepts.md)
- [Task recipes](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/recipes.md)
- [Limitations](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/limitations.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/troubleshooting.md)
- [Migration](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/migration.md)

## Version and language discovery

- [English release catalog](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/en/)
- [Catálogo en español](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/es/)
- [Machine-readable scopes, provenance and guides](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/versions.json)

Each scope supplies raw Markdown at /<language>/permission/<version>/raw/index.md. Development guides may contain unreleased API. Archived guides only appear for confirmed releases with verified immutable source and documentation identities.
